title: Let agents use a browser
subtitle: A real run of SpecWithCode 1.0.47 with Codex in a sample repo.

outro.next: Next: to use your real Chrome, see the SpecWithCode Browser extension docs
outro.note: Recorded headlessly in one take on a private SpecWithCode 1.0.47 server with a disposable home. Off camera: the welcome wizard, adding greet-app with Full access, turning Agent browser access off first, and a page reload before Take over. Agent waits are sped up where marked. The narration is an AI voice.
